europe_now.title: Widespread Unrest and Protests Across France
europe_now.summary: France faces severe civil unrest following violent protests that resulted in significant property damage and political fallout. President Emmanuel Macron has condemned the violence and rejected the interior minister's resignation offer as student demonstrations and security responses continue.
